description: This file defines a LightningJS component called 'Loader' which renders animated circles as a loading indicator. It includes properties for customization, state management, and lifecycle hooks.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A LightningJS component that displays an animated loader with three circles, fading in and out repeatedly.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts an interval that toggles the alpha transparency of the circles to create a blinking animation.
